say:0:1520804001:1.text: How many times must I tell you to stop?
say:0:1520804001:1.source_cn: 唉，老夫都喊了多少遍，让你们住手，怎么就是不听！

say:1:1520804002:1.text: Now you've angered the Great Hunting God and brought his wrath upon yourselves!
say:1:1520804002:1.source_cn: 偏要惹怒狩猎神大人，由<male>他</male><f...
say:1:1520804002:1.male: Now you've angered the Great Hunting God and brought his wrath upon yourselves!
say:1:1520804002:1.female: Now you've angered the Great Hunting Goddess and brought her wrath upon yourselves!

say:2:1520804003:1.text: That power... was that divine punishment?!
say:2:1520804003:1.source_cn: 那股强大的力量……是神罚？！

say:3:1520804004:1.text: You showed disrespect before the Hunting God. Punishment is deserved.
say:3:1520804004:1.source_cn: 你们在狩猎神面前失态，应当受到惩罚。
say:3:1520804004:1.male: You showed disrespect before the Hunting God. Punishment is deserved.
say:3:1520804004:1.female: You showed disrespect before the Hunting Goddess. Punishment is deserved.

choice_prompt:4:1520804004.text: You showed disrespect before the Hunting God. Punishment is deserved.
choice_prompt:4:1520804004.source_cn: 你们在狩猎神面前失态，应当受到惩罚。
choice_prompt:4:1520804004.male: You showed disrespect before the Hunting God. Punishment is deserved.
choice_prompt:4:1520804004.female: You showed disrespect before the Hunting Goddess. Punishment is deserved.

say:5:1520804005:1.source_cn: 原谅我们！我们一定会认真思过！

say:6:1520804006:1.text: Forgive me, Great Herdmaster! I just wanted to teach those two a lesson.
say:6:1520804006:1.source_cn: 对不起，伟大的狩猎神！我只是想给他们一点教训。
say:6:1520804006:1.male: Forgive me, Great Herdmaster! I just wanted to teach those two a lesson.
say:6:1520804006:1.female: Forgive me, Great Herdmaster! I just wanted to teach those two a lesson.

say:7:1520804007:1.text: Their behavior brings shame to all Wildborn.
say:7:1520804007:1.source_cn: 他们太轻浮了，实在是有辱雅库伯尔对他们的教导。
say:7:1520804007:1.male: Their behavior brings shame to all Wildborn.
say:7:1520804007:1.female: Their behavior brings shame to all Wildborn.

say:8:1520804008:1.text: I'll accept any punishment you deem fit... but please, don't take away our chances to compete in the Bloodhunt Festival!
say:8:1520804008:1.source_cn: 我愿意领受一切责罚，请您……无论如何都不要剥夺我们参加...
say:8:1520804008:1.male: I'll accept any punishment you deem fit... but please, don't take away our chances to compete in the Bloodhunt Festival!
say:8:1520804008:1.female: I'll accept any punishment you deem fit... but please, don't take away our chances to compete in the Bloodhunt Festival!

choice_prompt:9:1520804008.text: I'll accept any punishment you deem fit... but please, don't take away our chances to compete in the Bloodhunt Festival!
choice_prompt:9:1520804008.source_cn: 我愿意领受一切责罚，请您……无论如何都不要剥夺我们参加猎血节的资格！
choice_prompt:9:1520804008.male: I'll accept any punishment you deem fit... but please, don't take away our chances to compete in the Bloodhunt Festival!
choice_prompt:9:1520804008.female: I'll accept any punishment you deem fit... but please, don't take away our chances to compete in the Bloodhunt Festival!

say:10:1520804010:1.text: Yes! Since childhood, I've dreamed of winning the Bloodhunt Festival and becoming your chosen warrior!
say:10:1520804010:1.source_cn: 是的……我从小就想赢得猎血节的胜利，成为得您恩宠的勇士！
say:10:1520804010:1.male: Yes! Since childhood, I've dreamed of winning the Bloodhunt Festival and becoming your chosen warrior!
say:10:1520804010:1.female: Yes! Since childhood, I've dreamed of winning the Bloodhunt Festival and becoming your chosen warrior!

say:11:1520804011:1.text: Especially after witnessing your power—I pledge my eternal loyalty and dedicate my life to this goal!
say:11:1520804011:1.source_cn: 尤其是在刚才，亲眼见证过您的强大神力之后……我愿意永远...
say:11:1520804011:1.male: Especially after witnessing your power—I pledge my eternal loyalty and dedicate my life to this goal!
say:11:1520804011:1.female: Especially after witnessing your power—I pledge my eternal loyalty and dedicate my life to this goal!

choice:9:0:1.text: You want to fight in the Bloodhunt Festival that badly?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 你对猎血节就这么执着吗？
choice:9:0:1.male: You want to fight in the Bloodhunt Festival that badly?
choice:9:0:1.female: You want to fight in the Bloodhunt Festival that badly?

say:17:1520804009:1.text: For Wildborn warriors, taking part in the Bloodhunt is the greatest honor.
say:17:1520804009:1.source_cn: 对于雅库伯尔的战士而言，参加猎血节是最高的荣耀。
say:17:1520804009:1.male: For Wildborn warriors, taking part in the Bloodhunt is the greatest honor.
say:17:1520804009:1.female: For Wildborn warriors, taking part in the Bloodhunt is the greatest honor.

choice:4:0:1.text: Reflect on the errors of your ways.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 惩罚就算了，好好反省吧！
choice:4:0:1.male: Reflect on the errors of your ways.
choice:4:0:1.female: Reflect on the errors of your ways.

choice:4:1:2.text: No one steps out of line in my presence!
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 没错！谁敢在我面前造次！
